title: Nova Scotia Focuses on Microelectronics Integration
summary: Nova Scotia is prioritizing specialized component and hardware integration for subsea, security, and resource markets instead of building chip fabs.

title: NASA Unveils PROMISE Nuclear Moon Rover
summary: NASA announced plans to send the nuclear-powered PROMISE rover to the Moon's South Pole using repurposed Mars rover components.

title: Evaluating NewSpace-Grade NOR Flash Reliability
summary: A new technical paper examines radiation degradation effects in NOR Flash components and proposes a radiation requirement derivation method.

title: Ultra-Compact 16-Foot Tiny House Unveiled
summary: A new unnamed tiny house measuring just 16 feet long features a space-saving interior layout designed to maximize its minimal footprint.

title: Rhoda AI Expands Video Models for Robots
summary: Rhoda AI has extended its direct video action model with mobile DVA to help robots better understand the physical world.

title: Darlington SMR Will Miss 2030 Deadline and Budget
summary: Ontario Power Generation announced that the Darlington SMR project will exceed its budget and miss its October 2030 commercial operation target.

title: Hawk Ridge Systems and M5D Form 3D Printing Alliance
summary: Hawk Ridge Systems and M5D have formed a partnership combining engineering expertise with print technology experience.

title: BYD Unveils Robot-Powered EV Charging Station
summary: BYD has unveiled a charging station combining battery storage, megawatt flash charging, and a robotic automatic plug-in arm.

title: Turkey Selects AtkinsRéalis for Nuclear Feasibility Study
summary: AtkinsRéalis signed an agreement with Turkey's state-owned nuclear energy company to conduct a feasibility study on nuclear expansion.

title: Superheated Magma Delays Crystal Formation
summary: Experiments revealed that superheated magma can delay crystal formation for more than eight hours.

title: Brain Waste-Clearing Waves Impaired in Older Adults
summary: Researchers found that cerebrospinal fluid waves that clear brain waste during sleep are impaired in older adults.

title: Earth's Atmosphere Fueled May 2024 Solar Storm
summary: Satellite measurements revealed that 85% of the charged particles fueling a massive solar storm originated from Earth's upper atmosphere.

title: SimScale Launches Engineering AI Blueprint
summary: SimScale has launched its Engineering AI Blueprint featuring NVIDIA tools to help move engineering AI from pilots to broader deployment.

title: Magnetism Breakthrough Aims to Cut AI Chip Energy
summary: Researchers overcame the dead layer problem in thin magnetic materials to help slash the energy demands of AI computer chips.

title: AST SpaceMobile Eyes New Launch Vehicle
summary: AST SpaceMobile executives expressed confidence in developing a new reusable launch vehicle in two years.

title: Jake Hecla Tackles Nuclear Challenges
summary: An MIT assistant professor is developing tools to cool space-based reactors, detect nuclear weapons, and study emerging nuclear technologies.

title: Nvidia Confirmed Chip Tracking Feasibility
summary: Nvidia privately confirmed to a U.S. lawmaker that tracking chips to prevent smuggling is technically feasible.

title: Bubble-Powered Aquaticar Debuts as Amusement Park Ride
summary: The Aquaticar is a new amusement park ride vehicle that is powered entirely by bubbles.

title: ProtoVis-Nav Improves UAV Navigation
summary: Researchers introduced a prototypical visual imagination framework to improve vision-language navigation and reduce motion errors for UAVs.

title: DiSKO: Distribution Steering for Nonlinear Systems
summary: Researchers introduce a data-driven covariance steering framework for stochastic nonlinear systems using Koopman operator theory and deep neural networks.

title: HEIR Resource for Human-Robot Interaction Studies
summary: HEIR pairs human speech, gaze, and egocentric video with robot navigation and manipulation trajectories to study intent grounding and execution planning.

title: FanCyqlone Parallelized Solver for Optimal Control
summary: FanCyqlone is a linear solver exploiting temporal and scenario parallelism to speed up multi-horizon optimal control problems.

title: Collaborative Task Allocation via Iterative Clustering
summary: An iterative clustering algorithm partitions global multi-robot task allocation problems into tractable subproblems to improve team utility.

title: Generalized Gated Recurrent Units for System Identification
summary: The Generalized Gated Recurrent Neural Network unifies LSTM and GRU dynamics using continuous homotopies for nonlinear system identification.

title: XBot-Omni: Omni-Modal Model for Robotic Embodiment
summary: XBot-Omni extends the Omni paradigm to robotic modalities, combining a Thinker, Talker, and Actor architecture for embodied communication.

title: FORGE: Force-Aware Multi-Granularity Control
summary: FORGE provides a coarse-to-fine control system for humanoid loco-manipulation that integrates momentum observation and wrist-equivalent force estimation.

title: Europe Eyes Arctic Fiber Optic Cable Strategy
summary: The European Commission released a strategy plan to build an Arctic cable hub connecting Greenland to mainland Europe.

title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions for Robots
summary: SALA uses language descriptions of unpaired human and robot video clips to establish semantic correspondence for latent actions in embodied models.

title: TuMAP Pipeline Quantifies Renal Tubular Remodeling
summary: Researchers introduced TuMAP, a pathomics pipeline combining foundation models and statistical inference to quantify disease-associated renal tubular remodeling from kidney biopsy slides.

title: Pakistani Astronaut to Visit Tiangong Space Station
summary: A Pakistani pilot is set to become the first international visitor to China's Tiangong space station this month.
